segments.text: No one wants to be in an accident, that's why we take so many precautions.
segments.zh: 没有人想遭遇事故，这就是我们采取这么多预防措施的原因。

segments.text: We wear personal protective equipment and carefully select each piece of apparatus that
segments.zh: 我们穿戴个人防护装备，并仔细挑选我们所用的每一件

segments.text: we use.
segments.zh: 器具。

segments.text: But accidents do happen, no matter how many precautions we take.
segments.zh: 但无论我们采取多少预防措施，事故还是会发生。

segments.text: When they do, quick action is imperative, and a safety shower or eyewash can be a godsend.
segments.zh: 一旦发生，迅速行动至关重要，紧急喷淋或洗眼器可能就是救命稻草。

segments.text: There are several types of safety showers and eyewash stations.
segments.zh: 紧急喷淋和洗眼站有好几种类型。

segments.text: The best are simple.
segments.zh: 最好的是简单的那种。

segments.text: With one movement, the water starts the flow.
segments.zh: 只需一个动作，水就开始流出。

segments.text: The stream continues until a second movement is made to turn it off.
segments.zh: 水流会一直持续，直到做出第二个动作把它关掉。

segments.text: The flow of water in a safety shower must be strong enough to immediately drench the victim.
segments.zh: 紧急喷淋的水流必须足够强，能立即把伤者全身淋透。

segments.text: The unit should also provide enough water for at least 15 minutes of continuous use.
segments.zh: 该装置还应提供足够的水，至少能连续使用 15 分钟。

segments.text: Eyewashes need to produce a soft stream or spray of aerated water.
segments.zh: 洗眼器需要产生柔和的充气水流或水雾。

segments.text: This should also last for at least 15 minutes.
segments.zh: 这同样应至少持续 15 分钟。

segments.text: Acids and eyewashes should be located wherever corrosive, infectious, or other hazardous substances
segments.zh: 紧急喷淋和洗眼器应设置在任何有腐蚀性、感染性或其他危险物质

segments.text: exist.
segments.zh: 存在的地方。

segments.text: Corrosives can be especially harmful.
segments.zh: 腐蚀性物质可能特别有害。

segments.text: They can often cause severe damage to the skin and eyes.
segments.zh: 它们常常会对皮肤和眼睛造成严重损伤。

segments.text: Corrosives include strong acids and bases and both dehydrating and oxidizing agents.
segments.zh: 腐蚀性物质包括强酸和强碱，以及脱水剂和氧化剂。

segments.text: Nitric acid, for instance, produces a slow-healing, painful burn.
segments.zh: 例如，硝酸会造成愈合缓慢的疼痛灼伤。

segments.text: And hydroxide, a base can inflict severe damage to the eyes.
segments.zh: 而氢氧化物这种碱会对眼睛造成严重损伤。

segments.text: Of course, when you're working with these types of substances, you should always wear
segments.zh: 当然，在使用这类物质时，你应始终穿戴

segments.text: personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备。

segments.text: You should also read the substance's safety data sheets.
segments.zh: 你还应该阅读该物质的安全技术说明书。

segments.text: These will tell you each substance's ingredients, properties, and hazards.
segments.zh: 它们会告诉你每种物质的成分、性质和危害。

segments.text: Your facility's chemical hygiene plan will often provide additional information on the
segments.zh: 你们设施的化学品卫生计划通常会提供有关

segments.text: safe use of the chemicals.
segments.zh: 安全使用化学品的更多信息。

segments.text: No matter how safe you think you are, you should know the locations of the safety showers
segments.zh: 无论你觉得自己多么安全，你都应该知道你所在区域紧急喷淋

segments.text: and eyewashes in your area and how to use them.
segments.zh: 和洗眼器的位置，以及如何使用它们。

segments.text: In fact, you should know how to find them with your eyes closed.
segments.zh: 事实上，你应该做到闭着眼睛也能找到它们。

segments.text: It's important to make it easy for any victim to reach the showers and eyewashes in your
segments.zh: 让任何伤者都能方便地到达你们实验室的紧急喷淋和洗眼器，

segments.text: labs.
segments.zh: 这一点很重要。

segments.text: Keep access routes free of equipment and supplies.
segments.zh: 保持通道上没有设备和物品。

segments.text: Shower areas themselves must also remain clear.
segments.zh: 喷淋区域本身也必须保持畅通。

segments.text: The equipment should be routinely tested to make sure it's kept in peak condition.
segments.zh: 这些设备应定期测试，确保处于最佳状态。

segments.text: Accreditation agencies such as CAP and JCAHO require that showers and eyewashes be stress-tested
segments.zh: CAP 和 JCAHO 等认证机构要求对紧急喷淋和洗眼器进行压力测试，

segments.text: periodically.
segments.zh: 并且要定期进行。

segments.text: Your supervisor or safety manager will put together a schedule.
segments.zh: 你的主管或安全经理会制定一个时间表。

segments.text: Showers and eyewashes must function properly at all times.
segments.zh: 紧急喷淋和洗眼器必须始终正常运作。

segments.text: The water should be checked to make sure it's potable, not stagnant.
segments.zh: 应检查水质，确保是可饮用的，而不是滞留的死水。

segments.text: Results of the testing should be marked on a tag, dated, and initialed.
segments.zh: 测试结果应标记在吊牌上，注明日期并签上姓名缩写。

segments.text: If you're splashed by a hazardous substance, don't panic.
segments.zh: 如果你被危险物质溅到，不要惊慌。

segments.text: Call out for help and get to a shower or eyewash, depending on the extent of the splash.
segments.zh: 大声呼救，并根据溅到的范围，前往紧急喷淋或洗眼器处。

segments.text: If you find yourself helping with a victim, take charge.
segments.zh: 如果你在帮助一名伤者，就要主动负起责任。

segments.text: Make sure they are completely drenched.
segments.zh: 确保他们被完全淋透。

segments.text: It usually requires two helpers to handle everything.
segments.zh: 通常需要两名帮手才能处理好一切。

segments.text: Clothing should be soaked all the way through.
segments.zh: 衣物应该完全湿透。

segments.text: Remove all personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 脱下所有个人防护装备。

segments.text: Take special care with safety glasses and goggles.
segments.zh: 对安全眼镜和护目镜要格外小心。

segments.text: The victim's clothing should be removed to at least the underwear.
segments.zh: 伤者的衣物至少应脱到只剩内衣。

segments.text: This is no time for modesty.
segments.zh: 现在不是害羞的时候。

segments.text: Don't forget to remove their shoes as well.
segments.zh: 别忘了把他们的鞋子也脱掉。

segments.text: If there isn't a retention basin under the shower, the wastewater should be surrounded
segments.zh: 如果喷淋下方没有集水池，就应该用吸附材料把废水

segments.text: with absorbent material.
segments.zh: 围起来。

segments.text: This will help to prevent the spread of contamination.
segments.zh: 这有助于防止污染扩散。

segments.text: After the initial deluge, the victim can move to a restroom or locker room to continue
segments.zh: 在最初的大量冲淋之后，伤者可以转移到洗手间或更衣室继续

segments.text: the shower.
segments.zh: 冲淋。

segments.text: The victim should then remove the rest of their clothing.
segments.zh: 然后伤者应脱掉其余的衣物。

segments.text: The entire showering time should be no less than 15 minutes.
segments.zh: 整个冲淋时间不应少于 15 分钟。

segments.text: Anyone helping the victim may also be at risk.
segments.zh: 任何帮助伤者的人也可能面临风险。

segments.text: They will inevitably get wet, and while the shower dilutes the chemical that they're exposed
segments.zh: 他们不可避免地会被淋湿，虽然喷淋会稀释他们接触到的化学品，

segments.text: to, they may also need to decontaminate.
segments.zh: 但他们可能也需要去污。

segments.text: Disposal of the shower water can often be an issue.
segments.zh: 喷淋废水的处置常常是个问题。

segments.text: In some situations, the water will need to be disposed of as chemical waste.
segments.zh: 在某些情况下，这些水需要作为化学废物处置。

segments.text: This is especially true if the spilled substance is radioactive.
segments.zh: 如果溅出的物质具有放射性，就更是如此。

segments.text: Dressed off clothing should be decontaminated prior to normal laundering.
segments.zh: 脱下的衣物在正常洗涤之前应先去污。

segments.text: If the spilled substance is particularly hazardous, the clothing should be disposed of.
segments.zh: 如果溅出的物质特别危险，就应该把衣物丢弃。

segments.text: If there's a drain under the shower, you must know whether it empties into a storage
segments.zh: 如果喷淋下方有地漏，你必须知道它是排入储存

segments.text: tank or the sewer.
segments.zh: 罐还是下水道。

segments.text: If it's the sewer, your supervisor may need to alert outside agencies.
segments.zh: 如果是下水道，你的主管可能需要通知外部机构。

segments.text: And remember, if a shower does have a drain, water should be kept in the trap at all
segments.zh: 还要记住，如果喷淋确实有地漏，存水弯里应始终

segments.text: times.
segments.zh: 保持有水。

segments.text: This will keep sewer gases from seeping up into the room.
segments.zh: 这样可以防止下水道气体渗入室内。

segments.text: These gases can be both flammable and toxic.
segments.zh: 这些气体可能既易燃又有毒。

segments.text: If a chemical splashes into your eyes, an eye wash is what you should use.
segments.zh: 如果化学品溅入眼睛，你应该使用的是洗眼器。

segments.text: As we've said, it should provide a gentle, continuous stream of aerated water.
segments.zh: 正如我们说过的，它应该提供柔和、连续的充气水流。

segments.text: You must get to the eye wash as quickly as possible.
segments.zh: 你必须尽快到达洗眼器处。

segments.text: Hold the affected eye open with your fingers to get a complete rinse, both under and behind
segments.zh: 用手指撑开受影响的眼睛，以便彻底冲洗眼睑下方和

segments.text: the eyelid.
segments.zh: 后方。

segments.text: If only one eye was splashed, do not allow the water to transfer the contamination to
segments.zh: 如果只有一只眼睛被溅到，不要让水把污染物带到

segments.text: the other eye.
segments.zh: 另一只眼睛。

segments.text: Once again, wash the area for at least 15 minutes.
segments.zh: 同样，要冲洗该部位至少 15 分钟。

segments.text: The eye may feel better before then, but the damaging effects of many chemicals are
segments.zh: 在此之前眼睛可能就会感觉好些，但许多化学品的损伤作用

segments.text: sometimes slow acting.
segments.zh: 有时是缓慢发生的。

segments.text: Some portable eye wash units don't supply 15 minutes of water, so they can only be
segments.zh: 有些便携式洗眼装置供水不足 15 分钟，所以只能

segments.text: used for a quick initial wash.
segments.zh: 用于快速的初步冲洗。

segments.text: The victim will still need a complete 15-minute rinse.
segments.zh: 伤者仍然需要完整的 15 分钟冲洗。

segments.text: Most handheld drench hoses require constant hand pressure to operate.
segments.zh: 大多数手持式冲淋软管需要一直用手按压才能工作。

segments.text: This doesn't allow both hands to be free for manipulating the injured eye, so a drench
segments.zh: 这样就不能腾出双手来处理受伤的眼睛，所以冲淋

segments.text: hose shouldn't be used as an eye wash.
segments.zh: 软管不应当作洗眼器使用。

segments.text: Small eye wash bottles should only be used when there is absolutely nothing else.
segments.zh: 小型洗眼瓶只应在完全没有其他办法时使用。

segments.text: Then the victim will need to get to another source of water immediately.
segments.zh: 之后伤者需要立即到其他水源处冲洗。

segments.text: Remember, safety showers and eye washes are emergency equipment.
segments.zh: 记住，紧急喷淋和洗眼器都是应急设备。

segments.text: After they're used, the victim should get immediate medical attention.
segments.zh: 使用之后，伤者应立即就医。

segments.text: And all uses of showers and eye washes must be reported to your supervisor.
segments.zh: 而且每一次使用紧急喷淋和洗眼器都必须报告你的主管。

segments.text: Safety showers and eye washes are as fundamental to the laboratory as hoods and pipettes, and
segments.zh: 紧急喷淋和洗眼器对实验室来说，就像通风柜和移液管一样基本，

segments.text: you need to know how to use them in case of an emergency.
segments.zh: 你需要知道在紧急情况下如何使用它们。

segments.text: Let's review.
segments.zh: 我们来回顾一下。

segments.text: Know the locations of the safety showers and eye washes in your laboratory.
segments.zh: 知道你们实验室里紧急喷淋和洗眼器的位置。

segments.text: Keep roots to showers and eye washes clear.
segments.zh: 保持通往紧急喷淋和洗眼器的通道畅通。

segments.text: Know what steps to take if a chemical splash does occur.
segments.zh: 知道一旦发生化学品溅洒该采取哪些步骤。

segments.text: And get splashed victim's medical attention immediately.
segments.zh: 并让被溅到的伤者立即就医。

segments.text: By keeping your lab's safety showers and eye washes in good shape and knowing how to
segments.zh: 只要让实验室的紧急喷淋和洗眼器保持良好状态，并知道如何

segments.text: use them, you may be able to prevent a serious injury, even save someone's eyesight.
segments.zh: 使用它们，你也许就能防止一次严重的伤害，甚至挽救某个人的视力。
